step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates a three-step knowledge management pipeline (ingestion, knowledge representation, and retrieval) for oil and gas domain documents. Documents enter the system and are ingested by AWS Lambda, which orchestrates downstream AI/ML services and storage engines. First, Lambda sends raw data to custom-trained Amazon SageMaker models for classification and key fact extraction, receiving extracted facts back. Lambda then invokes Amazon Comprehend to perform NLP tasks such as sentence structure analysis and named entity recognition. The resulting structured knowledge graph is persisted into Amazon Neptune. Concurrently, Lambda sends raw text to Amazon OpenSearch (Elasticsearch) to support full-text search queries on unstructured information.

graph.name: Accenture Oil and Gas Knowledge Management Architecture
graph.notes: Architecture processes unstructured documents from oil and gas operations to extract structured facts into Amazon Neptune while indexing raw text in Amazon OpenSearch.

nodes.name: Documents
nodes.notes: Raw documents from client systems, including extraction reports, process logs, and internal communications.

nodes.name: Lambda
nodes.notes: Central orchestrator routing documents across ML models, structure analysis, graph database, and search cluster.

nodes.name: SageMaker
nodes.notes: Custom models trained specifically for oil and gas domain tasks like document classification and key fact extraction.

nodes.name: Comprehend
nodes.notes: AWS NLP service performing sentence-level analysis, named entity recognition, and part-of-speech tagging.

nodes.name: Neptune
nodes.notes: Graph database storing dynamic and evolving knowledge representations and relationships.

nodes.name: Elasticsearch
nodes.notes: Full-text search engine indexing raw unstructured text for free-text search fallback.

edges.notes: Raw incoming documents are passed into the Lambda ingestion function.
Lambda passes raw document content to custom SageMaker models for domain feature extraction.
SageMaker returns extracted key facts and document classifications back to Lambda.
Lambda passes extracted text to Amazon Comprehend for sentence structure analysis.
Lambda persists structured graph data into the Amazon Neptune knowledge graph database.
Lambda forwards raw unstructured information to Elasticsearch for full-text indexing.
